never_started_note: frames.py lists 27 never-started orders (9 + 18). 4 are not items (see never_started_excluded), leaving 23, and every one was classified from its decision rows. The cap of fifteen was not applied. 'cost' is the type's metal cost (no metal went in), and order_metal sums those costs.
mechanisms: Raider swarms at undefended build sites (U4, 11 frames, 458 metal: armsolar_12701, armllt_29515, armllt_23204, armsolar_29701, armllt_4438, armmex_4899, armmex_12914, armllt_28950, armmex_18665, armllt_7141, armmex_17056, plus 13 of the 23 never-started orders, whose builders died or fled): this game's Rover and Blitz swarms killed frames and builders at home and at forward extractors while the guard was away. Two parts were recoverable. (1) t2's 3:27 decision to send all of group_B west against the commander's 'keep two Blitzes at home', before the 11-armfav raid at 3:33 (armsolar_12701 and armllt_29515, 165 metal). (2) Builds started or walked into parties already in sight: the pick's 8:52 solar 480 from 4 armflash (armsolar_29701), and the list steps that walked builders into 6 and 10 armflash at G8 (armmex_12914, armmex_18665); 23 metal, plus 3 constructors that died with them.

A builder returning to its own unfinished frame starts a new one (U9 and its also, armllt_23890 and armllt_28950, 119 metal): the list re-sent 'armllt spot_70' at 7:38 at the same asked-for site, and the host's site search (Map_findClosestBuildSite) treated our standing 71% frame as an obstacle. It placed armllt_24004 64 elmos away, and the 71% frame decayed beside the working builder (armllt_23890, 60). At 8:04, the re-listed step meant as the turret under way was played as a further new Sentry, which was killed at 69% (armllt_28950, 59). Hands rule: a build whose site holds our unfinished frame of that type resumes that frame, and a step naming it is taken as done.

Orders that land on a frame without regard to it (armsolar_9171 and armllt_30702, 100 metal): t2's 'stop' flight list was written when the report showed the solar at 6% and landed 12 s later at 49%, at a site no enemy was hitting; then the builder was given away (armsolar_9171, 76; a stop result could name the frame and its share). The commander's D-gun on an armfav 30 elmos from its own frame destroyed that frame, and the report blamed 'unseen' (armllt_30702, 24; the D-gun move should keep its blast off our own frames, and the friendly-fire row should reach the fights line).
unread: Nothing was torn or unread. hands_window prints no menus for this log (picks and PLAYS only), so the menu's 'leaves ... which decays' words could not be quoted. floor.py's aband (2 per seat) equals frames.py's decayed count, but aband_m (seat 0: 5, seat 1: 2) is far below frames.py's metal in decayed frames (181 and 62), because floor takes the last sampled share after decay. Seat 1 was read through a symlink directory (record-1, jev-1, strategist-1, terrain-1 as seat 0) for hands_window and floor.
